Revised summary:
The DAYBREAK Phase 3 study in wAMD met primary endpoints for Zenkuda and tabirafusp alfa tedromer, showing non-inferior visual gains and strong retinal drying vs. aflibercept. Over half of patients achieved 6-month dosing intervals. Safety was consistent with existing therapies, and regulatory submissions are planned.
